In fact, the Quran states, "And they ask you about the orphan (dhu-ahr), say: 'To set right for him is best; and if you mingle your affairs with his, then fear not a loss, and if you fear that you will not do justice to him, then marry of the women who are lawful to you, two or three or four; and if you fear that you cannot do justice (to them), then one or an (slave) that your right hand possesses, that is more suitable, that you may not incline (to injustice) and that you may be fair (and kind). (An-Nisa 4:3) In this verse, the Quran emphasizes the importance of taking care of orphans and ensuring their well-being. Similarly, providing for your children's basic needs, such as food and clothes, is a righteous act that demonstrates your love and care for them. Therefore, in this scenario, spending your child support check on food and clothes for your kids is a right and just act, as it prioritizes their well-being and dignity.
